summary: TestFlight Round-3 (v1.0.11 / build 118) verification of the 12 bug fixes. Wrote and ran /app/backend/tests/test_iter86_testflight_round3.py — 12/12 tests PASS covering: onboarding wording (Bug 1) at both prompt + frontend override; screen-neutral George opener regardless of current_screen=home|lounge (Bug 3); /api/voice/transcribe reachable (Bug 4); 'Where am I?' no longer says 'Lounge' as a location (Bug 6); farewell 'No thanks' triggers a warm close without re-asking 'how can I help?' (Bug 8); (tabs)/_layout.tsx renders 'FP Café' title (Bug 7); GeorgeSpeakButton exists and is used by GeorgeOnboarding.tsx with georgeApi.speak cloud TTS (Bug 10); DM composer JSX order is TextInput → VoiceInputButton → dm-send (Bugs 9, 11); GeorgeEventCreation header renders BOTH 'Save for later' and 'Clear chat' labels unconditionally (Bug 5); event_edit_flow returns edit metadata on the summary turn so EventChangeSummaryCard can render (Bug 12); Bug 2 defensive useEffect at GeorgeEventCreation.tsx L93-97 restores turns from preApprovalHistoryRef if empty. CRITICAL P0 REGRESSION FOUND AND FIXED: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx had a duplicate <Tabs.Screen name="lounge"> declaration (line 157 AND line 162) plus orphaned comment text mid-JSX, causing the entire app to crash with 'Screen names must be unique: lounge,home,chats,lounge,friends,profile' immediately after login — user could not reach any tab. Cleaned up the duplicated declaration; the app now boots into /home, tab bar reads ['Home','Chats','FP Café','Friends','Profile'], tapping the 3rd tab navigates to /lounge showing FP Café pinned row. Post-fix live UI confirmed via mobile-viewport Playwright.

ui_bugs.issue: P0 CRITICAL — Duplicate <Tabs.Screen name="lounge"> declarations (line 157 AND 162) plus orphaned mangled comment text (lines 158-159 read 'right after Home so it's within thumb reach and mirrors the / messaging-first mental model users have from iMessage/WhatsApp. */}') caused expo-router to throw 'Screen names must be unique: lounge,home,chats,lounge,friends,profile' immediately after login, blocking the entire app. FIXED by removing the duplicate line 157 and re-forming the comment block. Verified live: tabs now render ['Home','Chats','FP Café','Friends','Profile']. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:153-164.

action_items: MAIN AGENT: The duplicate <Tabs.Screen name="lounge"> in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx was left over from the Round-2/Round-3 title rename. The block between line 156-164 is now clean; please re-verify the file after any further edits so the duplicate does not resurface. MAIN AGENT: Bug 2 (chat disappears after 'That looks right') safety net is code-visible at GeorgeEventCreation.tsx L93-97. Because reproduction requires a live LLM-driven flow to reach postApproval=true (not scriptable in one session without ~90s of turn work), please self-test the approval path on device before shipping Build 118. The preApprovalHistoryRef is populated in the celebration branch at L604; the useEffect that restores when turns.length===0 is L93-97 — that DOES depend on preApprovalHistoryRef being const-declared later at L283. Runtime works because closures capture the binding, but consider hoisting the useRef above the useEffect to make TDZ intent explicit for reviewers.
MAIN AGENT: Confirm on physical device that the new GeorgeSpeakButton actually plays cloud TTS (not device TTS) — cannot be verified in web preview (Bug 10).

rca_of_issue: P0 (tabs)/_layout.tsx crash — root cause: during the Round-2/Round-3 rename of the Lounge tab title to 'FP Café' plus the tab-order rewrite, a new <Tabs.Screen name="lounge" options={{ title: "FP Café" }} /> was inserted at the top of the <Tabs> body (line 157), but the *previous* declaration further down (line 162) was left in place. Additionally, a fragment of the OLD tab-order comment ('right after Home so it's within thumb reach and mirrors the / messaging-first mental model users have from iMessage/WhatsApp. */}') was left orphaned between the two declarations (lines 158-159), making the JSX visually messy but still parseable. Expo Router validates uniqueness of tab screen names at runtime and threw 'Screen names must be unique: lounge,home,chats,lounge,friends,profile' inside an error boundary the first time any authenticated user reached /home. Repro: log in → immediate crash card 'Something went wrong / Screen names must be unique...'. Fix: removed the duplicate line 157, consolidated the comment block, kept a single <Tabs.Screen name="lounge" options={{ title: "FP Café" }} /> at its proper position between Chats and Friends. Post-fix live check: expo-router boots cleanly, tab bar renders ['Home','Chats','FP Café','Friends','Profile'], tapping FP Café navigates to /lounge showing the pinned FP Café row + Founders Lounge cards.
